menu_bar_tooltips_debug_button_group: Tools for testing and editing the game.

menu_bar_tooltips_workspaces_button: Go to the workspace select page.

menu_bar_tooltips_columns_overlay: Choose which packet console columns are shown.

menu_bar_tooltips_reset_layout_button: Reset this workspace's pane sizes to its defaults (keeps your inputs).

visual_descriptions_network_mesh: A small internet: routers linked into a backbone, each with its own subnet of hosts, and packets following real hop-by-hop routes between them.
visual_descriptions_telemetry: Scrolling strip charts of control loops chasing setpoints that step every few seconds - overshoot, ringing and settling included.
visual_descriptions_kernel: Packets flowing through a Linux kernel's netfilter hooks - the path iptables rules act on - being filtered, dropped and rewritten along the way.
visual_descriptions_kalman: Vessels on looping courses, each reporting noisy position fixes that a filter turns into a smooth estimated track.
visual_descriptions_wave_grid: A grid of lines whose thickness shows waves rippling out from random points.
visual_descriptions_vector_field: A field of vectors pointing at the mouse, bent and swelled by gusts of wind.
visual_descriptions_constellation: A QAM receiver's constellation diagram: clouds of received symbols scattered around their ideal points.
visual_descriptions_dense_mesh: A much denser network, where traffic shows only as links thickening while packets cross them.
visual_descriptions_proximity: Points drifting across the screen, linked to every neighbor that comes within reach.
visual_descriptions_cycle: Takes turns showing every background, 20 seconds each.
menu_bar_buttons_stream_button: Start Streaming to JSON Capture File
menu_bar_buttons_stream_button_active: Stop Streaming to JSON Capture File
settings_tooltips_model_sprites: Which parts of the model canvases are drawn.
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_boat_in: Submarine map: draws both boats - the incoming one (as received) and the outgoing one (as sent on).
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_boat_out: Submarine map: Not drawn yet. (Boats draws both.)
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_path_in: Submarine map: draws both boats' trails.
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_path_out: Submarine map: Not drawn yet. (Paths draws both.)
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_grid_num: Submarine map: Not drawn yet. (Grid Lines draws the numbers.)
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_grid_lin: Submarine map: draws the grid, its axes, and its numbers.
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_ocean: Submarine map: fills the background with the ocean color.
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_room_the: HVAC house: draws the room's thermostat.
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_window: HVAC house: draws the leaky window and the cold air coming in.
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_vent: HVAC house: draws the heater vent and, while heating, the hot air coming out.
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_controll: HVAC house: draws the controller box.
HVAC house: draws the controller's thermostat, showing the temperature it acts on.
settings_tooltips_model_sprites_indicato: HVAC house: draws the heater command the controller is sending (OPEN/CLOSED).
settings_tooltips_model_colors: Colors for the model canvases: a theme color name from the list, or any color name or hex code.
settings_tooltips_model_colors_path_in: Submarine map: the incoming boat's trail (as received).
settings_tooltips_model_colors_boat_in_f: Submarine map: the inside of the incoming boat.
settings_tooltips_model_colors_boat_in_o: Submarine map: the outline of the incoming boat.
settings_tooltips_model_colors_path_out: Submarine map: the outgoing boat's trail (as sent on).
settings_tooltips_model_colors_boat_out_: Submarine map: the inside of the outgoing boat.
Submarine map: the outline of the outgoing boat.
settings_tooltips_model_colors_line_art: HVAC house: outlines of the room, window, vent, controller, and thermostats.
settings_tooltips_model_colors_fill: HVAC house: the inside of the room, controller, and thermostats.
settings_tooltips_model_colors_text: HVAC house: the thermostat and indicator text.
settings_tooltips_model_colors_coldness: HVAC house: cold air, and the indicator while the heater is off.
settings_tooltips_model_colors_hotness: HVAC house: hot air, and the indicator while the heater is on.
settings_tooltips_strip_chart_sprites: Which parts of the strip charts are drawn. Not used by the game yet.
settings_tooltips_strip_chart_colors: Colors for the strip charts: a theme color name from the list, or any color name or hex code.
settings_tooltips_strip_chart_colors_gri: The numbers, title, and axis labels.
settings_tooltips_strip_chart_colors_pat: One color per plotted line, in order - lines past the last color reuse them from the start.
settings_tooltips_background_enabled: Draw the animated background at all. Off shows a plain color.
settings_tooltips_background_visual: Which animation plays in the background.
settings_tooltips_background_animate: Let the background move. Off shows a still picture.
settings_tooltips_background_detailed: Show the background's extra detail in workspaces too - for the network, its packets. Title and lesson select pages always show it.
settings_tooltips_background_fps: Frames per second for the background animation (1-120). Lower is lighter on slower computers.
theme_editor_gallery_note: Example panels with made-up data, showing the theme as you edit it - hover, click and select to see those colors too.
settings_tooltips_themes: The default themes, then any you've imported. Hover one to see where it came from.
menu_bar_tooltips_settings_button: Open the settings page: appearance, background, language, saved data and more.
settings_page_notes_theme: Light or dark, and which theme. Changes show at once.
settings_page_row_notes_dark_mode: Dark backgrounds with light text, or the other way around. Every theme has both.
settings_page_row_notes_theme: The default themes, then any you've imported. Light or dark stays as it is.
settings_page_row_notes_theme_editor: Fine-tune every color and surface yourself, with sample panels to try them on.
settings_page_row_notes_import_themes: Opens the imported themes folder. Put theme files (.json) in it and they show up in the Theme list.
settings_page_row_notes_reset_theme: Back to the default theme, undoing every Theme Editor change. Light or dark stays as it is.
settings_page_notes_theme_reset: Put the theme and everything on this page back the way they started.
settings_page_notes_materials: The backgrounds of each kind of widget: its color (click it to pick another) and, if the theme allows transparency, how solid it is - for the mode you're editing (see General).
theme_materials_notes_window: Behind everything: the window and every page's background.
theme_materials_notes_panel: The drawer: each panel's menu bar and the frame around its contents, and the cards on the settings pages.
theme_materials_notes_card: What takes up most of a panel's drawer: cards, consoles, charts, maps, tables and trees.
theme_materials_notes_field: The deepest, in smaller bits: text boxes, the gaps between cards, and scrollbar troughs.
theme_materials_notes_overlay: Dropdown overlays, like the menu bar's groups.
theme_materials_notes_table_header: Column headers of tables and trees.
theme_materials_notes_alternate_row: Every other row of tables and trees - usually like Fields.
theme_materials_notes_tooltip: The boxes that show on hover.
theme_materials_notes_footer: The bar along the bottom of the window (unless it's set to see-through).
settings_page_notes_ink_materials: The colors of text, outlines and highlights - always solid.
settings_page_notes_data_materials: The colors data is drawn in - status text, models and chart lines - always solid. Each should stand out on Cards, and the chart lines from each other.
theme_materials_notes_menu_bar_text: Titles and labels on panels' menu bars.
theme_materials_notes_field_text: Text in text boxes, consoles and tables.
theme_materials_notes_accent_text: Text on selected rows and the selected tab.
theme_materials_notes_accent: Focus outlines, checked boxes, slider handles and dropdown overlays' outlines.
theme_materials_notes_border: Outlines of text boxes, tables and tabs.
theme_materials_notes_scrollbar_hover: A scrollbar handle under the mouse.
theme_materials_notes_muted_text: Quieter text: column headers, hints, and things that are off.
theme_materials_notes_good: Status that's fine: on, connected, running.
theme_materials_notes_warning: Status worth a look: off, or waiting.
theme_materials_notes_bad: Status that's wrong: errors, or disconnected.
theme_materials_notes_incoming: What comes in: received paths and boats on maps, and the other hosts on the network diagram.
theme_materials_notes_outgoing: What goes out: sent paths and boats on maps, and this computer on the network diagram.
theme_materials_notes_hot: Heat on models: hotness, and the heater.
theme_materials_notes_chart_1: A strip chart line - charts use these in order.
settings_page_notes_background: The animated picture behind the title pages and workspaces.
settings_page_notes_background_preview: See every background animation full-size, in both its detailed and simple versions.
settings_page_row_notes_visuals_demo: Open the Procedural Visuals page to try each animation and replay its startup. Back returns here.
settings_page_notes_background_reset: Put the background settings back the way they started.
settings_page_row_notes_reset_background: Every background setting back to its default.
settings_page_notes_performance_preset: Set the costliest settings at once. Changing any of them afterward makes it Custom.
settings_page_row_notes_performance_pres: Low for slow computers, High for smooth motion. Also sets the background's framerate and animation.
settings_page_performance_preset_notes_l: 5 fps panels, no antialiasing or transitions, still 10 fps background.
settings_page_performance_preset_notes_b: The defaults: 10 fps panels, 30 fps background.
settings_page_performance_preset_notes_h: 30 fps panels and charts, 60 fps background.
settings_page_notes_frame_rate: How often the app redraws. The background has its own framerate, on the Background tab.
settings_page_row_notes_ui_fps: Updates per second for every chart, map, table and readout (1-60). Higher is smoother but busier; lower is lighter on slower computers.
settings_page_row_notes_antialiasing: Smooth the edges of lines and text in charts, maps and the background. Off draws faster but jagged.
settings_page_row_notes_page_transitions: Animate changing pages and opening popups. Off switches instantly.
settings_page_notes_monitoring: Measure how well the app is keeping up. Measuring only happens while one of these is on.
settings_page_row_notes_performance_over: Show framerates, frame times, the slowest panels, page load and startup times in the corner. F3 also switches it.
settings_page_row_notes_performance_log: Print the same measurements to the console every few seconds, plus each page's load time.
settings_page_notes_network_helper: Run packet capture in a separate elevated process instead of the main app.
settings_page_row_notes_network_helper: Keeps the main app unprivileged and takes packet decoding off its thread, so heavy traffic lags less. Asks for administrator access when turned on; the main app no longer needs it. Takes full effect on the next workspace you open.
settings_page_notes_performance_reset: Put the performance settings back the way they started.
settings_page_row_notes_reset_performanc: Every performance setting back to its default. The background keeps its own settings.
settings_page_notes_display: How the app's window is shown.
settings_page_row_notes_fullscreen: Fill the whole screen. The Toggle Fullscreen keybind (F11 unless you change it) also switches it.
settings_page_row_notes_fade_in: On startup, the background color fades in, then the window opens, the page comes in, and the background animation starts.
settings_page_row_notes_fade_out: On quit, the window fades away instead of closing at once.
settings_page_notes_keybinds: Keyboard shortcuts that work on every page. Click a box and press the keys to bind them, or clear it to unbind. Keys already bound to another action move to this one. F3 always shows the performance overlay.
settings_page_row_notes_keybind_zoom_in: Make everything bigger by one step. Ctrl = works too while this is Ctrl +.
settings_page_row_notes_keybind_zoom_out: Make everything smaller by one step.
settings_page_row_notes_keybind_zoom_res: Put the zoom back to 100%. Unbound until you set it.
settings_page_row_notes_keybind_fullscre: Switch fullscreen on or off - the same as the Fullscreen checkbox above.
settings_page_row_notes_reset_keybinds: Every keybind back to its default.
settings_page_notes_language: The text the app shows comes from a labels file - load another one to change the language or wording.
settings_page_row_notes_labels_file: The labels file in use, on top of the default text.
settings_page_row_notes_load_labels: Pick a labels file to use. Anything it doesn't cover keeps its default text.
settings_page_row_notes_default_labels: Stop using the loaded file and go back to the default text.
settings_page_row_notes_favorite: The workspace the title page's Resume button opens. A workspace's Bookmark button sets this too.
settings_page_notes_access_point: The hardware access point the game connects through.
settings_page_row_notes_ap_config: Open the access point's own configuration page in your web browser.
settings_page_notes_saved_data: What the app has saved. Both of these ask before deleting anything, and can't be undone.
settings_page_row_notes_delete_workspace: Every workspace's saved entries, toggles and panel sizes go back to their defaults. Your settings here are kept.
settings_page_row_notes_delete_user_data: Everything: workspace data, captures, and every setting on this page. A full reset.
settings_page_notes_developer_mode: Tools for building and testing the game itself.
settings_page_row_notes_is_developer: Add the debug tools to every page's menu bar, and show them below.
settings_page_row_notes_debug_labels: Show every label's key instead of its text, to find which key a piece of text comes from.
settings_page_row_notes_workspace_editor: Open the editor for creating and changing workspaces.
settings_tooltips_surface_translucent: Let surfaces be as see-through as the theme makes them. Off, everything is solid.
settings_tooltips_surface_opacity: How panels, bars, cards, fields and buttons are drawn. How see-through each one is comes from the theme.
settings_tooltips_surface_invert_buttons: Give buttons the same text color as everything else, on a background close to the panels, with a clear outline - instead of colored buttons.
settings_tooltips_surface_reset: Set every setting here back to its default.
settings_tooltips_strip_chart_auto_fit: Zoom every strip chart to fit its recent data, instead of aligning their time axes.
settings_tooltips_strip_chart_auto_fit_m: How many seconds of history fit mode shows at most.
settings_tooltips_available: What this workspace offers at all. Refresh to apply - panels only check this while building.
settings_tooltips_available_wifi: Network action form: connect to a WiFi network.
settings_tooltips_available_nmap: Network action form: map the devices on the network.
settings_tooltips_available_arp: Network action form: put this computer between two devices.
settings_tooltips_available_dos: Network action form: flood a device with traffic.
settings_tooltips_available_sniff: Network action form: capture packets on the network.
settings_tooltips_available_nfq: Network action form: intercept and rewrite ModBus packets in transit.
settings_tooltips_available_ap_connect: Network action form: connect to the AP.
settings_tooltips_available_encryption: Network action form: switch the AP's encryption on or off.
settings_tooltips_available_ap_tunnel: Network action form: route device traffic only through the AP.
settings_tooltips_available_kalman: Network action form: switch the AP's Kalman filter on or off.
settings_tooltips_available_table: ModBus table form: live register values.
settings_tooltips_available_modify: ModBus table form: rewrite register values in transit.
settings_tooltips_available_mode: Defender ModBus form: the AP's operation mode.
settings_tooltips_register_presets: Picking one resets every register, then sets up the ones it lists.
footer_tooltips_wifi_disconnected: Not connected to any Wi-Fi network.
footer_tooltips_wifi_restore: Stopping the Wi-Fi form switches back to:
footer_tooltips_background_off: The background is off. Turn it on with Cool Background in Settings > Background.
footer_tooltips_background_theme_off: This theme turns the background off behind panels. It still plays on the title menu.
footer_tooltips_developer: Developer mode is on ("is_developer" in preferences.json) - debug tools are in every menu bar.
footer_tooltips_debug_labels: Debug labels are on - every label shows its key. Turn them off in Settings.
footer_tooltips_fps: UI frames per second: achieved / target. F3 shows the full performance overlay.
footer_tooltips_session: Time since the app started, at
title_footer_tooltips_issues: Open a GitHub issue for a bug or an idea
menu_bar_tooltips_theme_editor_new: Make a theme of your own, starting from a copy of any theme.
menu_bar_tooltips_theme_editor_make_buil: Save this theme into the app's built-in themes (assets/themes), to ship it.
menu_bar_tooltips_theme_editor_save: Save your changes to this theme's file - a built-in one's in assets/themes. Unsaved themes are marked with * in the list.
menu_bar_tooltips_theme_editor_selector: The theme you're editing: the built-in ones, then your own. Built-in themes can only be looked at (except in developer mode) - make a new theme from one to change it.
theme_editor_replace_built_in: There's already a built-in theme in {name}. Replace it?
theme_editor_made_built_in:
Saved as a built-in theme: {path}

It's in the theme editor now. To offer it in everyone's theme selector, add it to CURATED_THEMES in style.py.
settings_page_notes_theme_general: What this theme is called and what it's like.
theme_editor_row_notes_built_in: Built-in themes can't be changed, except in developer mode. Make a new theme from this one to edit a copy of it.
theme_editor_row_notes_name: What the theme is called in the theme lists.
theme_editor_row_notes_description: What the theme is like, or where it came from - shown when hovering it in the lists.
theme_editor_row_notes_dark_mode: Every theme has a dark and a light mode. Checked, you're editing (and seeing) the dark one; unchecked, the light one.
theme_editor_row_notes_transparency: Lets the theme's materials be see-through. Off, the theme is always solid, whatever their opacity.
theme_editor_row_notes_background: Whether workspaces and settings show the animated background in this theme. Off, the window's own color (or gradient) shows behind their panels instead. The title menu always shows it.
theme_editor_row_notes_background_blur: Blurs the background behind see-through panels, like frosted glass. -1 leaves it to each page.
theme_editor_row_notes_panel_radius: How rounded panels' corners are - 0 is square.
theme_editor_row_notes_panel_frame: How thick the frame of Panels material around each panel's contents is. Its scrollbar sits in it.
menu_bar_tooltips_view_button_group: How this page's models and charts look.
menu_bar_tooltips_home_button: Menu (Esc): workspaces, title, settings, help and quit.
menu_bar_tooltips_forward_button: Go forward again, to the page you went back from.
settings_page_notes_buttons: Every button, but the title menu's and the workspace list's. An opacity of 0 leaves out its background or its outline - a ghost button, or just an outline.
settings_page_notes_menu_buttons: The title menu's buttons and the workspace list's. The selected workspace looks hovered.
theme_editor_row_notes_button_radius: How rounded the corners are - 0 is square.
theme_materials_notes_button_hover: The background under the mouse (pressed, a shade darker).
theme_materials_notes_button_border: The line around them - 0% opacity for none.
theme_materials_notes_menu_button_hover: The background under the mouse, and the selected workspace's.
theme_materials_notes_menu_button_border: The line around them - 0% opacity for none.
theme_materials_notes_menu_button_hover_: Their text under the mouse, and the selected workspace's.
